note: Research proposal prepared from official documentation on 2026-11-08. All boundaries and tiers require human confirmation; no approval, authorship or review is asserted.

cli.label: GitHub Copilot CLI
cli.interface_and_execution_location: Standalone GitHub Copilot CLI on a local macOS workstation, authenticated to GitHub Copilot.
modes: Interactive terminal mode with manual approval
Programmatic prompt mode documented separately when relevant
cli.account_and_tier: Proposed: Copilot Free with GitHub sign-in; pending team confirmation. Tier-specific limits, model availability and enterprise-only controls are not generalized.
cli.model_support: GitHub Copilot model selection and Auto depend on the account and its available models; no model is pinned for the assessment.
included_components: Native CLI file and shell tools, custom instructions, plan mode, approval prompts, permission rules and optional local sandboxing
exclusions: VS Code agent mode, GitHub web chat, cloud coding agent and cloud sandboxes
BYOK, third-party MCP servers, plugins, added skills and enterprise administration
cli.instructions_and_permissions: Document the CLI custom instruction paths, manual permissions and tool allow/deny rules. Distinguish permission prompts from local sandbox restrictions.

version.documentation_note: Official pages accessed 2026-11-08, identified by converted-text and raw HTML hashes. Claims are not attributed to an installed or benchmarked binary.

app.label: GitHub Copilot app (Windows local)
app.interface_and_execution_location: Native Windows desktop coding interface using local project files and tools; model inference is hosted by the vendor.
modes: Interactive local desktop coding sessions; planning, approvals and other documented modes considered separately
platforms: Windows 11, native local execution; WSL and remote/cloud sessions excluded
app.account_and_tier: Proposed: Copilot Free with GitHub sign-in; pending team confirmation. Tier-specific limits, model availability and enterprise-only controls are not generalized.
app.model_support: GitHub Copilot model selection and Auto depend on the account and its available models; no model is pinned for the assessment.
included_components: Native project context, editing, command execution, review and permission controls
Native instruction, skill and MCP mechanisms only; no added connections
exclusions: CLI and IDE extensions as separate product surfaces
Cloud, SSH and WSL execution; consumer chat and non-coding modes
Added MCP servers, plugins, custom skills, external providers and enterprise administration
app.instructions_and_permissions: Assess app-specific modes, native local execution policy and documented shared configuration; never infer an OS sandbox from a Git worktree.
